program_name: Online Master of Arts in Museum and Curatorial Practices

programme_facts.value: Applicants must fulfill the requirements of both the Graduate College and the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts. Degrees in the social sciences (history, anthropology, archaeology) and the arts (art history, museum studies) are most helpful to prepare students, but not required.
